# agenco_custom_integration (Resource)

Manages a connector instance built from a Frontegg integration template. Use the agenco_integration_templates data source to discover available template IDs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "agenco_integration_templates" "available" {}

resource "agenco_custom_integration" "slack_sales" {
  application_id          = agenco_application.storefront.id
  integration_template_id = "slack"
  name                    = "Slack — Sales"

  # A slug lets a second Slack workspace live alongside this one.
  slug = "sales"

  api_names = ["chat", "conversations"]

  auth_type     = "oauth"
  client_id     = var.slack_client_id
  client_secret = var.slack_client_secret

  custom_configuration = jsonencode({
    defaultChannel = "#sales"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Application this connector belongs to.
- `integration_template_id` (String) Template the connector is built from, for example "slack". Immutable after create.
- `name` (String) Connector display name.

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key. Required when auth_type is api_key. The API returns it masked, so the configured value is kept in state.
- `api_names` (List of String) APIs to enable on create. Use enabled_apis to change them afterwards.
- `auth_type` (String) Authentication mode. One of: [oauth api_key].
- `base_url` (String) Override for the upstream API base URL.
- `client_id` (String) OAuth client ID. Required when auth_type is oauth and is_dev_creds_enabled is false.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth client secret paired with client_id.
- `custom_configuration` (String) Template-specific settings encoded as a JSON object string.
- `description` (String) Free-text description of the connector instance.
- `enabled_apis` (Map of Boolean) Per-API enablement, keyed by API name.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the connector is active.
- `is_dev_creds_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Frontegg development credentials are used instead of your own OAuth app.
- `slug` (String) Instance discriminator for installing more than one instance of the same template. Lowercase kebab-case, up to 64 characters. Immutable after create.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Custom integration ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import agenco_custom_integration.slack_sales 0a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-ef0123456789/22223333-4444-5555-6666-777788889999
```
